    """Apply a function to its arguments.

    This is useful for passing a callable with pre-bound arguments as an
    argument to higher-order functions like ``map``, ``filter``, etc.

    >>> def add(x, y):
    ...     return x + y
    >>> apply(add, 1, 2)

    >>> list(map(lambda x: apply(add, x, 10), [1, 2, 3]))
